zh: 侧栏收起成图标栏后，「进行中 / 已归档」控件与已归档列表随分区标题一起离开页面，宿主自己的分区按钮留在原处；侧栏重新展开时两者照旧回来。
en: With the sidebar collapsed to its icon rail, the In progress / Archived control and the archived list leave the page along with the section's heading, so the host's own section buttons stay clear; both return when the sidebar is wide again.
